setup: You are asked for the scalar projection of the vector $([[u1]], [[u2]])$ onto the vector $(3, 4)$.

steps.say: The scalar projection is the dot product divided by the length of the target. The dot product is $3 \times [[u1]] + 4 \times [[u2]]$.
The target $(3, 4)$ has length 5, so dividing the dot product by 5 gives the signed length of the shadow: [[answer]].
